_note: Hand-maintained inventory of what this platform ships and depends on but no package manager describes: the upstream Arduino SAM core (downloaded and repackaged by tools/ci/build-release.py) and the toolchain the board manager index points at. scripts/merge-components.mjs merges it into the cdxgen BOM and fails when a pinned entry no longer matches tools/ci/upstream.json. Licences were read from the upstream archives listed in each component's externalReferences.

root.name: due-arduino-core
root.description: autonomylogic:sam Arduino platform for the Arduino Due: arduino:sam built with arm-none-eabi-gcc 7-2017q4 as C++14

components.name: ArduinoCore-sam
components.description: Arduino SAM Boards core (Arduino API, Arduino Due variant, Wire library). Repackaged into the platform archive; only platform.txt is changed.

components.name: ArduinoCore-sam USB device stack and HID library
components.description: cores/arduino/USB (CDC, USBCore, USBDesc) and libraries/HID 1.0, bundled in ArduinoCore-sam 1.6.12.

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: per-file headers (Copyright Peter Barrett, ISC permission notice); PluggableUSB and USBAPI.h are LGPL-2.1-or-later and covered by ArduinoCore-sam

components.name: SPI
components.description: SPI library for the Arduino Due, bundled in ArduinoCore-sam 1.6.12.

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: libraries/SPI/src/SPI.cpp header: GPL version 2 or LGPL version 2.1

components.name: libsam (Atmel SAM Software Package)
components.description: SAM3X peripheral library, as sources and the prebuilt variants/arduino_due_x/libsam_sam3x8e_gcc_rel.a linked into every sketch. Bundled in ArduinoCore-sam 1.6.12; upstream carries no separate version.

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: system/libsam/source/*.c header 'SAM Software Package License' (BSD-style, one retention condition plus a no-endorsement clause)

components.name: CMSIS device support for Atmel SAM3/SAM4
components.description: CMSIS device headers and startup code for SAM3X8E, bundled in ArduinoCore-sam 1.6.12.

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: per-file headers 'SAM Software Package License'; a few files carry only an $asf_license$ placeholder

components.name: CMSIS
components.description: Cortex Microcontroller Software Interface Standard (core headers and DSP_Lib), bundled in ArduinoCore-sam 1.6.12.

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: system/CMSIS/CMSIS/README.txt (Revision V2.10) and 'CMSIS END USER LICENCE AGREEMENT.pdf'

components.name: arduino-usbserial for ATmega16U2 (LUFA)
components.description: USB-serial firmware sources and prebuilt hex images for the Due's ATmega16U2, based on LUFA 2010 (Dean Camera). Shipped in the archive; this platform never builds or flashes it.

properties.name: autonomy:delivery
properties.value: redistributed in the platform archive, not used

components.name: arm-none-eabi-gcc
components.description: GNU Arm Embedded Toolchain 7-2017-q4-major as published in Arduino's board manager index. Referenced by toolsDependencies, never redistributed by this repository.

properties.name: autonomy:delivery
properties.value: installed by the board manager from Arduino's index

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: share/doc/gcc-arm-none-eabi/license.txt and release.txt of the linux64 archive (hash above)

components.name: gcc
components.description: GCC from ARM/embedded-7-branch revision 255204, with libgcc and libstdc++ runtime libraries.

components.name: binutils
components.description: Assembler, linker and object tools, binutils-gdb commit b23dc97fe237a1d9e850d7cbeee066183a00630b (2.29 mainline snapshot, dated from the commit gdb reports).

components.name: newlib and newlib-nano
components.description: C library and libgloss linked into every sketch built with this platform (_NEWLIB_VERSION 2.5.0), newlib-cygwin commit 76bd5cab331a873ac422fdcb7ba5fe79abea94f0.

properties.name: autonomy:delivery
properties.value: part of arm-none-eabi-gcc 7-2017q4; linked into the user's firmware

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: license.txt section 'NEWLIB and LIBGLOSS': a collection of BSD-style and other permissive per-file licences

components.name: gdb
components.description: Debugger, binutils-gdb commit b23dc97fe237a1d9e850d7cbeee066183a00630b (8.0 mainline). Shipped in the toolchain; not used by compile or upload.

components.name: bossac
components.description: Flash programmer used to upload sketches to the Due. Referenced by toolsDependencies, never redistributed by this repository.

properties.name: autonomy:delivery
properties.value: installed by the board manager from Arduino's index

properties.name: autonomy:licence-source
properties.value: LICENSE at tag 1.6.1-arduino of arduino/BOSSA (Copyright ShumaTech)
